00be0b76bf74.en: “Hrrrrgggghh,” Gabiro replied with a pained grunt. He opened his eyes, looking at a worm about the size of his thumb rapidly burrowing itself on his hand. “Fuck!” Flinching, Gabiro pulled on the worm with all the waning strength that he had, tearing it in half, spilling its worm guts and blood everywhere, and throwing it into the ooze puddle.
00be0b76bf74.t: “Hrrrrgggghh,” Gabiro menjawab dengan rengusan kesakitan. Dia membuka matanya, memandang seekor ulat kira-kira sebesar ibu jarinya dengan pantas menggali masuk ke dalam tangannya. “Celaka!” Tersentak, Gabiro menarik ulat itu dengan sisa kekuatan yang semakin pudar yang ada padanya, mengoyakkannya separuh, menumpahkan isi perut dan darah ulat itu ke merata tempat, dan mencampakkannya ke dalam lopak lendir itu.

057ac048fb5a.en: Gabiro Sanbi Royal, a one-of-a-kind scientist, agitatedly raised his voice at his apprentice, Kibe. “Why the fuck did you bring me a dead bagarisa?” Gabiro’s old frail body and whitened eyes contrasted with his youthful, emotionally charged response; his nose twitched, sensing the pungent, musky odor of wet dog mixed with woody notes, with aftertaste of rotten smell coming from the dead bagarisa—a pig-like animal with tusks pointing downwards, famous for its pungent scent glands found at the base of its red mane, making it absolutely gleam in the sunlight. It’s beautiful to look at from afar, but you might gag up close.
057ac048fb5a.t: Gabiro Sanbi Royal, seorang saintis yang tiada tolok bandingnya, meninggikan suara dengan gelisah kepada pelatihnya, Kibe. “Kenapa celaka kau bawa aku bagarisa mati?” Tubuh tua Gabiro yang rapuh dan matanya yang memutih kontras dengan responsnya yang muda dan beremosi; hidungnya berkedut, menghidu bau hamis kasturi anjing basah bercampur nota kayu, dengan rasa akhir bau busuk yang datang dari bagarisa mati itu—haiwan seperti babi dengan taring menghala ke bawah, terkenal dengan kelenjar baunya yang hamis yang ditemui di pangkal surai merahnya, membuatkannya benar-benar berkilau di bawah cahaya matahari. Cantik dipandang dari jauh, tetapi kau mungkin termuntah dari dekat.

0f191cb97b5c.en: That’s definitely for Maiara—no way the other princess would ask for something like that. Kibe pondered more, looking at the dripping blood from Gabiro’s hands. Strange we would be doing something this experimental though. I mean, it’s just a fake body, so why are we going through the trouble? Kibe drew breath to speak, but then stopped himself short. Aww whatever. If Gabiro defunds the department’s monthly budget, then I will just take it up with Neferteri.
0f191cb97b5c.t: Itu memang untuk Maiara—mustahil puteri lain minta benda macam tu. Kibe merenung lagi, memandang darah yang menitis dari tangan Gabiro. Pelik juga kita buat benda seeksperimen ni. Maksud aku, ia cuma fake body, jadi kenapa kita susah-susah? Kibe menarik nafas untuk bercakap, tetapi kemudian menahan dirinya. Alah lantaklah. Kalau Gabiro habiskan bajet bulanan jabatan, aku bawa je perkara ni kepada Neferteri.

193d302d5f07.en: This is ancient stuff! Is this still for Maiara? Kibe, meanwhile, stayed silently watching whatever Gabiro was attempting to do. His eyes shifted to the box filled with nari stones—a stone encapsulated by a green wood frame that allowed multiple stones to be chained together, forming a stick. Each stone had a blue hue inside that felt like a trapped gas of sorts, appearing as if the blue would swirl around if you shook it with your hand. Glancing at the size of each stick, and the sheer amount of them, Kibe gasped, “There’s like ten per stick? Did you use our entire budget for this?” Kibe’s eyes grew serious for once, “Am I gonna get my salary tomorrow?”
193d302d5f07.t: Ni benda purba! Ni masih untuk Maiara ke? Kibe, sementara itu, terus memerhati dalam diam apa sahaja yang cuba dilakukan Gabiro. Matanya beralih kepada kotak yang dipenuhi batu nari—batu yang dibungkus bingkai kayu hijau yang membolehkan beberapa batu dirantai bersama, membentuk sebatang kayu. Setiap batu mempunyai warna biru di dalamnya yang terasa seperti sejenis gas yang terperangkap, kelihatan seolah-olah biru itu akan berpusar jika kau menggoncangnya dengan tangan. Mengerling saiz setiap batang, dan banyaknya, Kibe tercungap, “Ada macam sepuluh sebatang? Awak guna seluruh bajet kita untuk ni ke?” Mata Kibe menjadi serius buat sekali ini, “Saya dapat gaji esok ke?”

1e2367279685.en: Kibe, turning himself away from viewing such a decrepit body, glanced around the room. A closed door, a few bookshelves, and wooden drawers encircled them, but that was it. He suddenly realized there was something crucial missing as his eyes widened. “Wait! Where’s the guy? The body!”
1e2367279685.t: Kibe, memalingkan dirinya dari melihat tubuh yang begitu uzur, mengerling sekeliling bilik. Pintu yang tertutup, beberapa rak buku, dan laci kayu mengelilingi mereka, tetapi itu sahaja. Dia tiba-tiba menyedari ada sesuatu yang penting yang tiada ketika matanya terbeliak. “Kejap! Mana lelaki tu? Mayat tu!”

26be9d7809ec.en: With his heart pounding, Kibe still could not move. He watched Gabiro scream in pain, his body slowly melting away into a white fiery ooze. Kibe could not fathom a thought, watching with pure fearful awe the growing brightness of the two ooze clusters, roaring in flames as they drew closer to one another, nearly touching.
26be9d7809ec.t: Dengan jantung berdegup kencang, Kibe masih tidak dapat bergerak. Dia melihat Gabiro menjerit kesakitan, tubuhnya perlahan-lahan cair menjadi lendir putih yang menyala. Kibe tidak mampu berfikir, memerhati dengan kagum dan takut yang tulen kecerahan dua kelompok lendir yang semakin bertambah, mengaum dalam api ketika ia semakin mendekati antara satu sama lain, hampir bersentuhan.

281871aa082f.en: Tightly clenching his teeth, Gabiro made a nerve pop up in his forehead. He seemed to hold back for what seemed an instant, but soon after he extended his hand towards the dead bagarisa, and exploded verbally. “Were you smoking Sanbi shit? How is a fucking bagarisa the most powerful thing?” A fly, perusing the corpse, decided to switch targets, and headed straight into Gabiro’s open mouth. Coughing, he spit the fly out. “Dammit, Kibe! Why the fuck didn’t you use ice create?”
281871aa082f.t: Mengetap giginya kuat-kuat, Gabiro membuatkan satu urat timbul di dahinya. Dia kelihatan menahan diri seketika, tetapi tidak lama kemudian dia menghulurkan tangannya ke arah bagarisa mati itu, dan meletup secara lisan. “Kau hisap benda apa, demi jiwa tua Sanbi? Macam mana bagarisa celaka ni boleh jadi benda paling berkuasa?” Seekor lalat, yang meninjau bangkai itu, memutuskan untuk menukar sasaran, dan terbang terus ke dalam mulut Gabiro yang terbuka. Terbatuk-batuk, dia meludahkan lalat itu. “Sial, Kibe! Kenapa celaka kau tak guna ice create?”

2a6bf50fe605.en: Prologue subchapter 2: the old scientist works glowing light around his arm over the carcass while the silver-haired man watches, arms crossed.
2a6bf50fe605.t: Prolog subbab 2: saintis tua itu menggerakkan cahaya bersinar di sekeliling lengannya di atas bangkai sementara lelaki berambut perak memerhati sambil berpeluk tubuh.

2d846ad080b0.en: 1039 A.G Paulin 14th, Gannday at about Sunnilow. Another beautiful average summer morning, with a humid wind carrying hints of salty, fishy air, contrasting with a warming sun tickling the skin. Birds doing birdy things, fish doing fishy things, and humans … doing fishy things too. Amongst all the commonality of what would be just another day, two people stood by themselves on the fourth floor of Sanbi Kingdom’s Castle Southwest tower, with one of them clearly not looking pleased.
2d846ad080b0.t: 14 Paulin 1039 A.G, Gannday sekitar Sunnilow. Satu lagi pagi musim panas biasa yang indah, dengan angin lembap membawa bayu masin dan hanyir, kontras dengan matahari yang menghangatkan menggeletek kulit. Burung-burung membuat hal burung, ikan-ikan membuat hal ikan, dan manusia … membuat hal yang mencurigakan juga. Di tengah-tengah semua kebiasaan hari yang sepatutnya biasa, dua orang berdiri sendirian di tingkat empat Menara Barat Daya Istana Kerajaan Sanbi, dengan salah seorang daripadanya jelas kelihatan tidak gembira.

2e052e4d5e46.en: “You’re out.” Kibe, grabbing one of the nari sticks, placed the pointy edge of the blue nari stones towards the bloodied palm.
2e052e4d5e46.t: “Dah habis.” Kibe, mengambil salah satu batang nari, meletakkan hujung tajam batu nari biru itu ke arah tapak tangan yang berdarah.

307dbb61daf0.en: “Well, they called it the amethyst smelly killer.” Kibe let go of Gabiro’s stick as he felt the jabs stop. His eyes finally had enough courage to glance back at Gabiro, rubbing his hand on his chin.
307dbb61daf0.t: “Yalah, mereka panggil dia pembunuh busuk amethyst.” Kibe melepaskan tongkat Gabiro apabila dia merasakan cucukan itu berhenti. Matanya akhirnya cukup berani untuk mengerling semula Gabiro, menggosok tangannya di dagu.

3105fd0c06bf.en: Kibe avoided eye contact with Gabiro’s exposed skin, but his eyes were just curious enough to bring them back. “White balls?” Kibe paid close attention to how ghastly white the balls were. “What are we doing messing with the soul? That’s dangerous!”
3105fd0c06bf.t: Kibe mengelak bertentang mata dengan kulit Gabiro yang terdedah, tetapi matanya cukup ingin tahu untuk kembali memandang. “Bola putih?” Kibe memberi perhatian rapi pada betapa putih pucatnya bola-bola itu. “Apa kita buat main-main dengan jiwa? Itu bahaya!”

386ad124a87e.en: “Enough time? You had two fucking days! That’s why we are meeting here instead, you asshole!” Gabiro immediately shot down the argument, shooing away the other curious flies from his mouth—perhaps Gabiro’s old age was just as fragrant as the dead bagarisa’s.
386ad124a87e.t: “Masa yang cukup? Kau ada dua hari celaka! Sebab tulah kita jumpa kat sini, bangsat!” Gabiro serta-merta mematahkan hujah itu, menghalau lalat-lalat lain yang ingin tahu dari mulutnya—mungkin usia tua Gabiro sama harumnya dengan bagarisa mati itu.

3c98de644f24.en: A numbing feeling appeared next, followed by intense comforting warmth, like entering a hot tub in the middle of the winter. Kibe’s vision, fussy and tunneling, spotted a torn up room, with a weakening white fire on top of the table, slowly revealing a corpulent human body. He tried to move his neck, but it didn’t budge. He tried to move his fingers, but they refused to acknowledge its owner. A breath, maybe he could breathe—nope. He was stuck, paralyzed inside his own dying body.
3c98de644f24.t: Rasa kebas muncul seterusnya, diikuti kehangatan menenangkan yang kuat, seperti masuk ke tab air panas di tengah-tengah musim sejuk. Penglihatan Kibe, kabur dan menyempit, ternampak bilik yang berselerak, dengan api putih yang semakin lemah di atas meja, perlahan-lahan mendedahkan tubuh manusia yang gempal. Dia cuba menggerakkan lehernya, tetapi ia tidak berganjak. Dia cuba menggerakkan jarinya, tetapi ia enggan mengakui pemiliknya. Satu nafas, mungkin dia boleh bernafas—tak. Dia tersekat, lumpuh di dalam tubuhnya sendiri yang sedang nazak.

3ca03cb46c95.en: 1039 A.G Paulin 14th, Gannday at about Sunnilow. Another beautiful average summer morning, with a humid wind carrying hints of salty, fishy air, contrasting…
3ca03cb46c95.t: 14 Paulin 1039 A.G, Gannday sekitar Sunnilow. Satu lagi pagi musim panas biasa yang indah, dengan angin lembap membawa bayu masin dan hanyir, kontras dengan…

410be2d5fcd8.en: “Pfff. Three aquamarines are more than fucking enough. I could have negotiated for a Darfaries corpse with that kind of money. You’re not even trying! You dipshit!” A boastful speech came from Gabiro, but then his eyes narrowed as he grew suspicious. “How much did this shit cost?”
410be2d5fcd8.t: “Pfff. Tiga aquamarine dah lebih daripada cukup, celaka. Aku boleh berunding untuk mayat Darfaries dengan duit sebanyak tu. Kau langsung tak berusaha! Bodoh sial!” Ucapan berlagak keluar daripada Gabiro, tetapi kemudian matanya mengecil kerana dia semakin curiga. “Berapa harga benda celaka ni?”

4307e1bd0d73.en: Getting paid good money to do this ain’t bad. Kibe, dropping the used nari chain in the ground like a filthy smoker would throw out a cigarette butt, grabbed another chain, and repeated the process. His satisfaction started to wane, as he mechanically kept feeding one chain of nari after the other into Gabiro’s palm, leaving behind an almost empty box. “Eleven.” Kibe confirmed the eleventh ball of double helices had just come into existence by itself in the third ring, after a lot more than eleven nari chains were fed into it.
4307e1bd0d73.t: Dapat gaji lumayan untuk buat ni tak teruk pun. Kibe, menjatuhkan rantai nari terpakai ke lantai seperti perokok kotor membuang puntung rokok, mengambil rantai lain, dan mengulangi proses itu. Kepuasannya mula pudar, ketika dia secara mekanikal terus menyuapkan rantai nari satu demi satu ke dalam tapak tangan Gabiro, meninggalkan kotak yang hampir kosong. “Sebelas.” Kibe mengesahkan bola heliks berganda kesebelas baru sahaja muncul dengan sendirinya di gelang ketiga, selepas jauh lebih daripada sebelas rantai nari disuapkan ke dalamnya.

44340d49af40.en: Oops. A strained smile appeared on Kibe’s face, slowly rubbing his suddenly sore neck. “Two aquamarines and three amethysts.” His voice sounded sure on the surface, but hollow inside, just like a new facade of a crumbling building.
44340d49af40.t: Alamak. Senyuman tegang muncul di wajah Kibe, perlahan-lahan menggosok lehernya yang tiba-tiba sengal. “Dua aquamarine dan tiga amethyst.” Suaranya kedengaran yakin di permukaan, tetapi kosong di dalam, sama seperti fasad baharu sebuah bangunan yang runtuh.

444c5a79bed4.en: “Of course not! I didn’t tell them we were experimenting with a new fake skin.” Kibe’s hand moved by itself towards his nose to scratch a sudden itch.
444c5a79bed4.t: “Mestilah tak! Saya tak bagi tahu mereka kita tengah bereksperimen dengan fake skin baru.” Tangan Kibe bergerak sendiri ke arah hidungnya untuk menggaru gatal yang tiba-tiba.

44d80a49fac8.en: “DAMMIT, KIBE—” Before Gabiro could finish his sentence, the flame reached his elbow, gaining momentum as it dissolved everything on its path. Letting go of his arm, he grabbed the knife with his only hand, and stabbed his shoulder. He grunted from the pain—the same white ooze poured from the stab wounds, rather than blood. “KIBE! FUCK! Do something! Cut my head off!” Gabiro moved his old frail hand towards Kibe, and tried to take a step, but didn’t move very far. “NOW!”
44d80a49fac8.t: “SIAL, KIBE—” Sebelum Gabiro sempat menghabiskan ayatnya, api itu sampai ke sikunya, semakin laju ketika ia melarutkan segala-galanya di laluannya. Melepaskan lengannya, dia mengambil pisau itu dengan satu-satunya tangan yang tinggal, dan menikam bahunya. Dia merengus kesakitan—lendir putih yang sama mencurah dari luka tikaman itu, bukannya darah. “KIBE! CELAKA! Buat sesuatu! Penggal kepala aku!” Gabiro menggerakkan tangannya yang tua dan rapuh ke arah Kibe, dan cuba melangkah, tetapi tidak bergerak jauh. “SEKARANG!”

496cc4daa75f.en: “Ahhhh—” Frozen in space, Kibe only let out a murmur, seeing Gabiro’s forearm becoming oozy and pooling in the ground.
496cc4daa75f.t: “Ahhhh—” Membeku di tempatnya, Kibe hanya mengeluarkan gumaman, melihat lengan bawah Gabiro menjadi berlendir dan berlopak di lantai.

506aa7c947fd.en: Gabiro clenched his left hand, but left his middle and ring fingers out flat—kinda as if he was flipping the bird. When he did so, he caused a bluish fire to emerge from his left hand, and arm. It danced back and forth, like the flame of a gas stove if you move the gas dial back and forth. Even though this ethereal-like flame seemed to be in direct contact with his skin, it did appear to cause any kind of burns. As if he was practicing a ritual handed down through the generations, he then proceeded to touch the two left fingers into the right palm and moved the clenched right fingers to envelop the left fingers, looking just like a Venus flytrap catching flies. With absolute, confident trapping motions of the right hand, appearing as if it was eating the left fingers, a rhythmic wave of bluish excited flames arose high on the left arm and hand, before rushing towards Gabiro’s sagging, bleeding palm of his right hand. As it clashed, the blue flames disappeared inside the palm, all while a white ball with a trailing tail composed of double helix strands, like a yarn ball made of DNA, emerged into existence and spun around on the smallest ring around Gabiro’s right arm, as if trying to free itself.
506aa7c947fd.t: Gabiro mengepal tangan kirinya, tetapi membiarkan jari tengah dan jari manisnya lurus—agak seperti dia menunjukkan isyarat lucah. Apabila dia berbuat demikian, dia menyebabkan api kebiruan muncul dari tangan dan lengan kirinya. Ia menari ke depan dan ke belakang, seperti api dapur gas jika kau memutar tombol gas ke depan dan ke belakang. Walaupun api yang seperti alam ghaib ini kelihatan bersentuhan langsung dengan kulitnya, ia tidak kelihatan menyebabkan sebarang jenis lecur. Seolah-olah dia mengamalkan ritual yang diwarisi turun-temurun, dia kemudian menyentuhkan dua jari kiri ke tapak tangan kanan dan menggerakkan jari kanan yang terkepal untuk menyelubungi jari kiri, kelihatan seperti pokok periuk kera Venus menangkap lalat. Dengan gerakan memerangkap tangan kanan yang mutlak dan yakin, kelihatan seolah-olah ia memakan jari kiri, gelombang api kebiruan yang teruja secara berirama naik tinggi di lengan dan tangan kiri, sebelum menerpa ke arah tapak tangan kanan Gabiro yang kendur dan berdarah. Ketika ia bertembung, api biru itu hilang di dalam tapak tangan, sementara sebiji bola putih dengan ekor yang terdiri daripada helaian heliks berganda, seperti bola benang yang diperbuat daripada DNA, muncul dan berputar pada gelang paling kecil di sekeliling lengan kanan Gabiro, seolah-olah cuba membebaskan dirinya.

510e3888d7e6.en: If you’re going to be this much of a jerk, then you should have just gone to pick it up yourself. Kibe, still finding things to look at other than Gabiro, tried to mince his words as his wide shoulders shrugged. “Huh—well, first. You didn’t give me enough time or—”
510e3888d7e6.t: Kalau awak nak kerek macam ni, baik awak pergi ambil sendiri. Kibe, masih mencari benda lain untuk dipandang selain Gabiro, cuba memilih kata-katanya ketika bahunya yang lebar terangkat. “Huh—okey, pertama. Awak tak bagi saya masa yang cukup atau—”

56f18f2f344d.en: Refusing to acknowledge Kibe, Gabiro clenched the fingers of his right hand, leaving the bleeding palm exposed. A trail of harmless white fire emerged from his middle and ring fingers, and rushed up his arm, in a vein-like pattern, towards his back. Afterwards, five circles of white fire popped into existence around his right arm—surging from the white fire in his arms. Gabiro let out a long-frustrated groan, and began chanting, almost as if he had memorized it like the lyrics of a catchy, but cringy song. “A man out of this world! He needs to stand big and tall, but not a giant like Darfaries. He must be assertive, yet charismatic! A true listener!”
56f18f2f344d.t: Enggan mengendahkan Kibe, Gabiro mengepal jari tangan kanannya, membiarkan tapak tangan yang berdarah terdedah. Satu jejak api putih yang tidak berbahaya muncul dari jari tengah dan jari manisnya, dan menerpa naik lengannya, dalam corak seperti urat, ke arah belakangnya. Selepas itu, lima bulatan api putih muncul di sekeliling lengan kanannya—terpancar dari api putih di lengannya. Gabiro mengerang panjang dengan kecewa, dan mula melaungkan, hampir seolah-olah dia menghafalnya seperti lirik lagu yang mudah melekat tetapi menggelikan. “Seorang lelaki dari luar dunia ini! Dia perlu berdiri besar dan tinggi, tetapi bukan gergasi seperti Darfaries. Dia mesti tegas, namun berkarisma! Seorang pendengar sejati!”

5eda7d50703d.en: The jab attempts stopped. Gabiro now looked at the dead Bagarisa with a meticulous scientific glint in his eyes. “Was it that hard to hunt it down?”
5eda7d50703d.t: Percubaan mencucuk itu berhenti. Gabiro kini memandang Bagarisa mati itu dengan sinar saintifik yang teliti di matanya. “Susah sangat ke nak buru dia?”

5f167b12d062.en: Like a flashbang, a suddenly blinding flash lit up the entire room, taking over his senses, including his capability of thought.
5f167b12d062.t: Seperti bom kilat, kilauan yang tiba-tiba menyilaukan menerangi seluruh bilik, mengambil alih derianya, termasuk keupayaannya untuk berfikir.

64ba998ad23e.en: “No logogram?” Kibe could not help himself, taking a peek into the bleeding carvings in Gabiro’s rubbery skin.
64ba998ad23e.t: “Tak ada logogram?” Kibe tidak dapat menahan diri, mengintai ukiran berdarah di kulit Gabiro yang seperti getah.

739c37f98f26.en: Gabiro sharply asked, “What did you tell them?”
739c37f98f26.t: Gabiro bertanya dengan tajam, “Apa kau bagi tahu mereka?”

7de80640e90d.en: That’s new. Kibe, speechless, and incapable of blinking, watched every detail of the white fire as it slowly swallowed the entire bagarisa corpse, like a snake eating a deer. The flaming white ooze began to spread on the table, slowly inching to its edges like thick molasses. “What interface is that?”
7de80640e90d.t: Yang ni baru. Kibe, terkedu, dan tidak mampu berkelip, memerhati setiap butiran api putih itu ketika ia perlahan-lahan menelan seluruh bangkai bagarisa, seperti ular menelan rusa. Lendir putih yang menyala itu mula merebak di atas meja, perlahan-lahan menjalar ke tepinya seperti molases pekat. “Antara muka apa tu?”

857ebff760cd.en: “AWW! FUCK!” Gabiro clenched his teeth. Looking at the hole left behind by the worm, he saw the same white flame oozing out. “AW SHIT! QUICK! Grab the knife!” Gabiro held his right arm, applying as much pressure as he could, trying to restrict the blood flow, while a white curtain of flame constantly marched steadily towards his forearm, liquefying his own flesh and making it drip onto the ground.
857ebff760cd.t: “AWW! CELAKA!” Gabiro mengetap giginya. Memandang lubang yang ditinggalkan ulat itu, dia nampak api putih yang sama meleleh keluar. “ALAMAK SIAL! CEPAT! Ambil pisau tu!” Gabiro memegang lengan kanannya, menekan sekuat mungkin, cuba menyekat aliran darah, sementara tabir api putih terus berarak dengan mantap ke arah lengan bawahnya, mencairkan dagingnya sendiri dan membuatkannya menitis ke lantai.

8b4760d94a70.en: I hope he buys it. Kibe, appearing to use his muscle reflexes, grabbed the end of the trembling walking stick, and calmly held back the attempted stabs. Breaking eye contact, he slightly shrugged, “Expensive, yes, but I had no choice. The two aquamarine adventurers did not want to negotiate! They said they brought it back from south of Hifuna to mount as a trophy.”
8b4760d94a70.t: Harap dia percaya. Kibe, nampaknya menggunakan refleks ototnya, memegang hujung tongkat yang menggeletar itu, dan dengan tenang menahan percubaan menikam itu. Memutuskan pandangan mata, dia mengangkat bahu sedikit, “Mahal, ya, tapi saya tak ada pilihan. Dua pengembara aquamarine tu tak nak berunding! Mereka kata mereka bawa balik dari selatan Hifuna untuk dijadikan trofi.”

9336fdee4ca4.en: Gabiro sized up the corpse, paying close attention to its large, wide back, and impressive dark red mane. Gabiro’s chin-stroking paused as his eyes shifted back to Kibe. “You didn’t tell them what this was for, right?”
9336fdee4ca4.t: Gabiro menilai bangkai itu, memberi perhatian rapi pada belakangnya yang besar dan lebar, dan surai merah gelapnya yang mengagumkan. Usapan dagu Gabiro terhenti ketika matanya beralih semula kepada Kibe. “Kau tak bagi tahu mereka benda ni untuk apa, kan?”

93c1323c49e8.en: Like waking up from a dream, Kibe took a deep breath, opening his eyes, but now he saw himself in a private hot spring accompanied by large friendly humanoids that he could not fully identify. The comforting warmth, the natural forest aroma in the air, plus the company of people he liked meant the world to him. He relaxed his face, dipping further into the hot water with a vacant mind.
93c1323c49e8.t: Seperti bangun dari mimpi, Kibe menarik nafas dalam, membuka matanya, tetapi kini dia melihat dirinya di kolam air panas peribadi ditemani makhluk berupa manusia yang besar dan mesra yang tidak dapat dikenal pastinya sepenuhnya. Kehangatan yang menenangkan, aroma hutan semula jadi di udara, serta teman-teman yang disukainya bermakna segala-galanya baginya. Dia mengendurkan wajahnya, merendam lebih dalam ke dalam air panas dengan fikiran yang kosong.

960b63c4efbd.en: Gabiro, disrobed down to his blue boxers with white fish symbols, was browsing the drawers. Without even looking at Kibe, he continued to search for something. “We’re doing something different today.” With his left hand, he grabbed a simple-looking short knife that contained beautiful carving of a fish jumping, and stood back in front of the corpse. Both hands were in front of him, close to chest level. His left hand held the knife pointed towards the right palm, which was laid with its fingers laid out flat, as if trying to high-five the knife.
960b63c4efbd.t: Gabiro, yang sudah menanggalkan pakaian hingga tinggal seluar dalam biru dengan simbol ikan putih, sedang menyelongkar laci. Tanpa memandang Kibe pun, dia terus mencari sesuatu. “Kita buat benda lain hari ni.” Dengan tangan kirinya, dia mengambil sebilah pisau pendek yang kelihatan ringkas yang mempunyai ukiran cantik ikan melompat, dan berdiri semula di hadapan bangkai itu. Kedua-dua tangan di hadapannya, berhampiran paras dada. Tangan kirinya memegang pisau yang dihalakan ke arah tapak tangan kanan, yang diletakkan dengan jari-jarinya rata, seolah-olah cuba bertepuk tangan tinggi dengan pisau itu.

9b8f9f347cd3.en: Gabiro clenched his hand, making the blue hue inside the nari stone rush towards the palm, leaving behind an empty, crystalline, diamond-like stone.
9b8f9f347cd3.t: Gabiro mengepal tangannya, membuatkan warna biru di dalam batu nari menerpa ke arah tapak tangan, meninggalkan batu kristal seperti berlian yang kosong.

a2d59a1cad4a.en: “Sorry. What?” Kibe was still remembering the intricacies of how he got to know Lukino, so he was half-heartedly paying attention.
a2d59a1cad4a.t: “Maaf. Apa?” Kibe masih mengingati selok-belok bagaimana dia mengenali Lukino, jadi dia memberi perhatian dengan separuh hati.

ab8d179cccee.en: Gabiro entrapped his left fingers again, but this time things behaved differently. The blue flames of his left forearm rushed thought the hand, and into the palm, then flamed out, while no new white ball of DNA appeared in the rings once he stopped entrapping.
ab8d179cccee.t: Gabiro memerangkap jari kirinya lagi, tetapi kali ini keadaan berlaku berbeza. Api biru di lengan bawah kirinya menerpa melalui tangan, dan masuk ke tapak tangan, kemudian padam, sementara tiada bola DNA putih baharu muncul pada gelang apabila dia berhenti memerangkap.

b068bf39f193.en: Gabiro took a deep breath, closing his eyes. “Because I felt like it. Now shut the fuck up, and get ready to feed nari until we reach eleven.” Gabiro proceeded to slice open his palm, making two similarly sized squares, leaving the first square empty and making a plus sign inside the other.
b068bf39f193.t: Gabiro menarik nafas dalam, memejamkan matanya. “Sebab aku rasa nak. Sekarang diam, celaka, dan bersedia untuk suap nari sampai kita sampai sebelas.” Gabiro terus menghiris tapak tangannya, membuat dua segi empat yang sama saiz, membiarkan segi empat pertama kosong dan membuat tanda tambah di dalam yang lagi satu.

b1495325acf5.en: “—that’s why I didn’t tell you the truth, you dumbass.” These words slipped out under Gabiro’s breath, barely making it to Kibe.
b1495325acf5.t: “—sebab tulah aku tak bagi tahu kau perkara sebenar, bebal.” Kata-kata ini terlepas perlahan dari mulut Gabiro, hampir tidak sampai kepada Kibe.

b4fb6ddb0da6.en: “And you didn’t go into the details?” Gabiro raised one of his white, hairy eyebrows.
b4fb6ddb0da6.t: “Dan kau tak cerita butirannya?” Gabiro mengangkat sebelah keningnya yang putih dan berbulu.

b72fb00627cc.en: “Whatever. They are going to spend all the balls on the pub anyway—let’s get this shit over with.” Gabiro placed his walking stick on the table, and proceeded to disrobe by untangling the blue ribbon on his stomach, and opening his bathrobe-like clothing like he was a diva—full of prideful elegance.
b72fb00627cc.t: “Lantaklah. Mereka akan habiskan semua bola kat pub pun—jom kita selesaikan benda celaka ni.” Gabiro meletakkan tongkatnya di atas meja, dan mula menanggalkan pakaian dengan meleraikan reben biru di perutnya, dan membuka pakaiannya yang seperti jubah mandi seperti seorang diva—penuh keanggunan yang angkuh.

b919e59aebba.en: Seeing the white fire consuming the worm, liquefying it into the ooze, Kibe felt a primordial fear strike at his chest. He stepped back, just in case whatever this ooze thing was started to crawl towards him as it began to drip onto the floor.
b919e59aebba.t: Melihat api putih itu memakan ulat itu, mencairkannya menjadi lendir, Kibe merasakan ketakutan purba menyerang dadanya. Dia berundur, untuk berjaga-jaga sekiranya apa pun benda lendir ini mula merangkak ke arahnya ketika ia mula menitis ke lantai.

bb0badde86b1.en: Kibe remembered meeting with the two adventurers, then happening to go drinking with one of them, a taller muscled human by the name of Lukino. His mind was slightly sparse on the details, possibly due to over indulging in talking to Lukino amidst pounding a few beers in a local bar. At the same time, he for sure remembered renting the most expensive room to get to know that adventurer through means other than talking. “Noooo—?” Kibe’s voice ended with somewhere between an exclamation and a question, holding back what appeared to be another grin forming.
bb0badde86b1.t: Kibe teringat berjumpa dengan dua pengembara itu, kemudian kebetulan pergi minum dengan salah seorang daripada mereka, seorang manusia berotot yang lebih tinggi bernama Lukino. Fikirannya agak samar tentang butirannya, mungkin kerana terlalu asyik berbual dengan Lukino di tengah-tengah meneguk beberapa bir di bar tempatan. Pada masa yang sama, dia pasti ingat menyewa bilik paling mahal untuk mengenali pengembara itu melalui cara selain bercakap. “Tak adaaa—?” Suara Kibe berakhir di antara seruan dan soalan, menahan sesuatu yang kelihatan seperti satu lagi sengihan yang terbentuk.

ca893d308e2b.en: Five white balls of DNA appeared on the soul rings: two on the smallest one, closest to Gabiro’s wrist, and three on the following ring.
ca893d308e2b.t: Lima bola putih DNA muncul pada gelang jiwa: dua pada yang paling kecil, paling dekat dengan pergelangan tangan Gabiro, dan tiga pada gelang berikutnya.

dc1f8706622e.en: “I didn’t tell them anything!” Kibe’s voice trailed as his eyes began looking away again. Well, I guess I did tell them a bit. His voice trailed off, “Other than say it was for an experiment—”
dc1f8706622e.t: “Saya tak bagi tahu apa-apa pun!” Suara Kibe semakin perlahan ketika matanya mula memandang ke arah lain lagi. Yalah, rasanya aku ada bagi tahu sikit. Suaranya semakin hilang, “Selain cakap ia untuk eksperimen—”

dd98919c5300.en: A loud shush came from Gabiro. His eyes were forcibly shut, and his brows furrowed firmly, continuously speaking out loud, “His body needs to be muscular, yet he must be a comfortable body pillow—he needs to be fertile, and his schlong needs to be hard as rock, and veiny as a weightlifter, but not as big as a Darfaries’s. His balls must be filled with fertility, and warm to the touch. His eyes must be sparkly green, his hair must be golden blonde, and he must not have a beard, or body hair.”
dd98919c5300.t: Satu “syyy” yang kuat datang dari Gabiro. Matanya dipejam rapat dengan paksa, dan dahinya berkerut kuat, terus bercakap dengan kuat, “Tubuhnya perlu berotot, namun dia mesti bantal peluk yang selesa—dia perlu subur, dan batangnya perlu keras seperti batu, dan berurat seperti ahli angkat berat, tetapi tidak sebesar milik Darfaries. Telurnya mesti penuh dengan kesuburan, dan hangat apabila disentuh. Matanya mesti hijau berkilauan, rambutnya mesti perang keemasan, dan dia mesti tidak berjanggut, atau berbulu badan.”

e4a11540c5bf.en: Kibe watched the knife, ready to cut Gabiro’s old frail skin. “Okay—that’s why we are going old-school?”
e4a11540c5bf.t: Kibe memerhati pisau itu, bersedia untuk memotong kulit tua Gabiro yang rapuh. “Okey—sebab tu ke kita guna cara lama?”

e70d48511873.en: Meanwhile, with deep breaths and beads of sweat running down his forehead, Gabiro placed his right hand in the bloating corpse. His face clenched in revulsion and disgust as the corpse juices dirtied his saggy hand. As Gabiro slowly unclenched his fingers, it ripped apart the rotting skin, exposing the worms from underneath having a feast on the dead flesh. The rings around his arms collapsed into one another, growing brighter as they rushed towards the hand, traveling through the wrist, and exploding outward from the palm with a white flame that covered the butt of the bagarisa corpse, appearing to liquify the flesh from within.
e70d48511873.t: Sementara itu, dengan nafas dalam dan manik peluh mengalir di dahinya, Gabiro meletakkan tangan kanannya ke dalam bangkai yang kembung itu. Wajahnya berkerut kerana loya dan jijik ketika cecair bangkai itu mengotorkan tangannya yang kendur. Ketika Gabiro perlahan-lahan membuka genggaman jarinya, ia mengoyakkan kulit yang reput, mendedahkan ulat-ulat dari bawah yang berpesta dengan daging mati itu. Gelang-gelang di sekeliling lengannya runtuh ke dalam satu sama lain, menjadi semakin terang ketika menerpa ke arah tangan, melalui pergelangan tangan, dan meletup keluar dari tapak tangan dengan api putih yang menyelubungi punggung bangkai bagarisa itu, kelihatan mencairkan daging dari dalam.

e72c49b3713f.en: He’s crankier than usual. A ponderous apprentice by the name of Kibe moved his eyes around the unusually large specimen of bagarisa, while avoiding glancing back at the source of the accusing voice. “You’re the one who asked me to bring the most powerful thing around.”
e72c49b3713f.t: Dia lagi meragam daripada biasa. Seorang pelatih yang suka termenung bernama Kibe menggerakkan matanya mengelilingi spesimen bagarisa yang luar biasa besar itu, sambil mengelak memandang semula sumber suara yang menuduh itu. “Awak yang suruh saya bawa benda paling berkuasa yang ada.”

ec6f4a7f2a69.en: “—huh—second, you only gave me three aquamarines.” Kibe paused, waiting for the counterargument which surely was going to come. And here we go again—
ec6f4a7f2a69.t: “—huh—kedua, awak cuma bagi saya tiga aquamarine.” Kibe terhenti, menunggu hujah balas yang pasti akan datang. Dan mulalah lagi—

f16519b86766.en: Kibe felt himself levitating, as if he was going down on an intense roller coaster, only to have a sudden feeling of being crushed as if a drunk truck driver rear ended him.
f16519b86766.t: Kibe merasakan dirinya melayang, seolah-olah dia sedang menurun di roller coaster yang hebat, hanya untuk tiba-tiba merasakan seperti dihancurkan seolah-olah pemandu trak yang mabuk merempuhnya dari belakang.

f1ac90e41920.en: Prologue subchapter 1: a silver-haired man and an old scientist with a blue head stripe argue over a dead tusked boar-like animal on a table.
f1ac90e41920.t: Prolog subbab 1: seorang lelaki berambut perak dan seorang saintis tua dengan jalur biru di kepala bertengkar di atas haiwan seperti babi hutan bertaring yang mati di atas meja.

f7971145aefb.en: “WHAT?” Gabiro raised his walking stick, covered in cyan fish scales, and prepared to jam it on Kibe’s guts. His trembling hands raised the massive weight of the stick—it was just a normal walking stick, but it was simply too much for Gabiro’s bulimic forearms.
f7971145aefb.t: “APA?” Gabiro mengangkat tongkatnya, yang dilitupi sisik ikan biru kehijauan, dan bersedia untuk menyucuknya ke perut Kibe. Tangannya yang menggeletar mengangkat berat tongkat yang besar itu—ia hanyalah tongkat biasa, tetapi terlalu berat untuk lengan bawah Gabiro yang kurus kering.
